short_name.notes: Official abbreviation used throughout AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet (e.g., AU Intro Days, AU Housing) and international.au.dk.

min_standing_note.value: Bachelor-level courses are open to 2nd- and 3rd-year students (typically >=30 ECTS in field); Master-level courses are reserved for Master's students (>=60 ECTS in field; Law Master's >=100 ECTS).

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Normalized from agreement_scope_raw == 'University-wide' (faculty/subject exclusions documented in excluded_majors and course_restrictions_note).

eligible_majors.notes: Normalized from agreement_scope_raw == 'University-wide' (subject-level exclusions noted in excluded_majors).

value: Medicine (limited clinical capacity; specific bilateral placement required)
excluded_majors.notes: Dentistry (Danish-only) and Medicine (limited clinical capacity) exclusions documented on AU Course Information & Restrictions page; AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet (Brev.pdf#page=3) separately states the 1-faculty/1-department rule.

min_gpa_host.notes: No centralized university-wide minimum GPA published in AY 2026-2027 fact sheet or AU incoming exchange pages.

english_course_availability.notes: AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p.3 states 'A wide variety of courses are taught in English. However, the selection of courses varies from semester to semester.'

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Expected English proficiency comparable to TOEFL iBT 83 or IELTS 6.5 (no RHET 1020 exemption stated). Documentation varies by faculty: Aarhus BSS (none required); Health (none required); Arts (required for English degree programme only); Natural Sciences and Technical Sciences (documentation may be required).

host_language_requirement.value: None required for English-taught exchange courses (Danish required only for Danish-taught courses such as Dentistry; optional Danish language courses offered).
host_language_requirement.notes: Dentistry Danish-language rule documented on AU Course Information & Restrictions page; optional Danish language courses linked in Brev.pdf#page=4.

fall_term_dates.value: Autumn semester (AY 2026-2027): Mandatory AU Intro Days late-August/early-September; Courses late-August to late-January; Exam period mid-December to late-January (exact dates vary by study programme).

spring_term_dates.value: Spring semester (AY 2026-2027): Mandatory AU Intro Days late-January/early-February; Courses late-January to late-June; Exam period mid-May to late-June (exact dates vary by study programme).

tuition_model.notes: Tuition-free bilateral exchange under active AUC agreement; also see https://international.au.dk/education/admissions/exchange.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p.4 publishes 'Monthly estimate 1.000' EUR (itemized breakdown sums to 805-1,055 EUR: Housing 350-600 EUR, Meals 300 EUR, Books 25 EUR, Local transportation 30 EUR, Personal expenses incl. insurance 100 EUR). Official web also notes AU Housing ~3,000-4,000 DKK/mo and SIRI visa financial threshold DKK 7,086/mo.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Converted from AU AY 2026-2027 official monthly estimate of 1,000 EUR over 5 months: 1000 EUR * 5 * FX rate 1.1052 USD/EUR = 5,526.00 USD. FX rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD (and 1 EUR = 7.4756 DKK; 1 DKK = 0.147841 USD) from ECB Euro reference exchange rates for 2026-11-13 (latest prior to 2026-11-15), retrieved 2026-11-15 at https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: No mandatory host tuition or student union fee stated for exchange students. Stays >3 months are covered by Danish Health Insurance once issued a CPR number; stays <3 months require private health insurance. Students must arrange private travel, personal belongings, accident, and third-party liability insurance.

housing_availability.notes: AU Housing assists incoming exchange students via an optional portal integrated with admission, but explicitly states housing is not guaranteed.

housing_notes.value: Optional AU Housing application is integrated into the admission application (deadlines Apr 1 Autumn / Oct 1 Spring). No housing guarantee; offers sent by Jul 1 (Autumn) and Dec 15 (Spring) with a 48-hour acceptance window requiring credit/debit card payment of 600 DKK non-refundable booking fee + first month's rent (deposit of 1-3 months' rent billed with 2nd month's rent). Estimated AU Housing rent 350-600 EUR/mo (~3,000-4,000 DKK/mo); AU advises applying to Student Housing Aarhus (Ungdomsbolig Aarhus) as backup.
housing_notes.notes: Timing and 350-600 EUR estimate also corroborated in Brev.pdf#page=2 and #page=4.

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: Erasmus+ is EU-programme-specific and Danish Government Scholarships apply to full-degree students; no incoming bilateral exchange grant confirmed for AUC students.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EEA students staying >3 months require a Danish student residence permit via SIRI. Normal processing takes up to 2 months (~60 days; up to 3 months if additional documentation is needed). Financial proof required: monthly funds matching the Danish SU grant benchmark (DKK 7,086/month at 2025 level, covering the full stay) in the student's own bank account.

exchange_page_url.notes: Official incoming exchange URL embedded as hyperlink in AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p.4.

course_catalog_url.notes: Official Aarhus University English course catalogue portal.

english_course_list_url.notes: No separate static English-only course list URL; filter Teaching language = English and Course type = Exchange at https://kursuskatalog.au.dk/en/.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS; full-time study workload is 30 ECTS per semester (Danish grading scale: 12, 10, 7, 4, 02 passing; 00, -03 fail; some pass/fail exams).

course_restrictions_note.value: Students must select courses from 1 faculty only (and most faculties allow 1 department only, per Brev.pdf#page=3). Law offers no Bachelor-level English courses (Master-level Law requires >=100 ECTS); Dentistry is Danish-only via faculty agreements; Medicine international semester has limited clinical capacity and requires Bachelor/3 years Medicine, C1 English, and clinical experience.
course_restrictions_note.notes: 1-faculty/1-department rule corroborated in Brev.pdf#page=3; Law/Dentistry/Medicine subject rules come from AU official web course-information-restrictions.

value: Official university transcript of records (PDF in English)
Bachelor's degree diploma & transcript (if already earned and applying for Master-level courses)
Documentation of English language skills (faculty/department-dependent; not required for Aarhus BSS or Health)
Passport number (entered in the online application form)
required_application_docs.notes: Required document checklist verified at international.au.dk (and .../education/exchange/how-to-apply); faculty-specific English documentation rules detailed in Brev.pdf#page=3.

academic_style.value: Informal classroom culture with flat hierarchy (first-name basis with faculty), open critical discussion, and independent study; some courses enforce mandatory attendance for exam eligibility.

city_tier.notes: Aarhus is Denmark's second-largest city (>370,000 inhabitants per international.au.dk), mapped to mid_size_city.

campus_type.notes: Aarhus University operates nationwide campuses in Aarhus (main campus), Emdrup (Copenhagen), Herning, Viborg, Roskilde, and Flakkebjerg.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: au.dk explicitly notes Denmark ranks among the highest countries globally in English proficiency and accommodates English speakers in daily life and university services.

international_support_services.value: Mandatory AU Intro Days (orientation before semester start with CPR/residence guidance, campus tours, social events), mentor/buddy contact via email where applicable, AU International Student Guide app, and Danish language courses.
international_support_services.notes: Further student arrival and mentor/language details on Brev.pdf#page=4.

nomination_deadlines.value: Autumn semester (AY 2026-2027): Nomination 15 Feb - 25 Mar, Application 1 Mar - 1 Apr. Spring semester (AY 2026-2027): Nomination 15 Aug - 25 Sep, Application 1 Sep - 1 Oct (housing application deadline is the same).
nomination_deadlines.notes: Also listed in nomination summary table on Brev.pdf#page=1.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived monthly cost from AY 2020-2021 Fact Sheet p.3 exact printed semester items divided by 5 months: Min = Komachi Residence 90,000 + Bedding & Cleaning 20,000 + Initial 2-wk meal plan 14,670 + 10-meal plan 60,000 + Textbooks 15,000 = 199,670 JPY / 5 = 39,934 JPY/mo; Max = Sakura Village (Fall) 184,000 + Bedding & Cleaning 20,000 + Initial 2-wk meal plan 14,670 + 21-meal plan 102,690 + Textbooks 50,000 = 371,360 JPY / 5 = 74,272 JPY/mo (excludes refundable 20,000 JPY deposit and 20,000 JPY activity fee; newer aiu.ac.jp pages cite textbooks ~50,000-70,000 JPY and housing ~130,000-215,000+ JPY/semester).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate derived from monthly JPY range 39,934-74,272 (midpoint 57,103.0)/month. ECB cross-rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD and 1 EUR = 176.83 JPY -> 1 JPY = 0.006250 USD (2026-11-13, retrieved 2026-11-15 at https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html); 5-month USD est = 57,103.0 JPY * 5 * 0.006250 = 1,784.49 USD.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Bilateral exchange students are EXEMPT from the French CVEC student life fee (obtain free exemption certificate at cvec.etudiant.gouv.fr per Campus France/etudiant.gouv.fr). Registration for French Sécurité Sociale (etudiant-etranger.ameli.fr) is mandatory for stays >3 months, plus third-party civil liability insurance (~EUR 10).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: CVEC exemption rules verified via official French student portal (etudiant.gouv.fr / campusfrance.org); ameli portal via https://etudiant-etranger.ameli.fr/#/.

housing_availability.notes: No on-campus dormitories; emlyon assists incoming students via its dedicated Studapart platform, private student residences (e.g., Nomad Campus), and homestay/intergenerational partners.

housing_notes.value: Off-campus/private residences supported via emlyon's Studapart portal and partner residence networks in Lyon.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU students staying >90 days must obtain a French VLS-TS long-stay student visa via Etudes en France (pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/etudesenfrance) / France-Visas before departure. Effective August 1, 2026, Décret n° 2026-526 increased minimum student financial proof from EUR 615/mo to EUR 877.50/month (EUR 10,530/year; 47% of gross SMIC).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Visa portals also listed at https://france-visas.gouv.fr/en/web/france-visas/visa-wizard and https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/etudesenfrance.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS system. Global BBA exchange: 25–35 ECTS per semester (Year 3/4 courses). Master in Management (MiM): 2 to 6 graduate elective courses per semester (standard 5 ECTS / 24 contact hours each, ~27.5–30 ECTS full load).
credit_system_and_load.notes: MiM rules confirmed on https://em-lyon.com/en/exchange-students-master-management.

course_restrictions_note.value: Undergraduate exchange students select from Global BBA Year 3 or Year 4 courses; graduate exchange students select from MiM electives (2–6 courses).

campus_type.notes: Urban Lyon Gerland campus located at 144 avenue Jean Jaurès, 69007 Lyon.

international_support_services.value: Incoming Students desk, Studapart housing portal, First Steps in France visa/Sécurité Sociale onboarding support.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall Semester: partner nomination May 1, student application May 15. Spring Semester: partner nomination October 1, student application October 10.

host_language_requirement.value: C1 German proficiency required only if enrolling in German-taught modules; no German required for English-taught modules. Optional German courses offered (6 ECTS during semester; optional 1-month intensive August course before Winter semester for a fee).

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Winter semester (available under Academic Year option): Mandatory orientation 19–20 Aug 2026; Bachelor lectures 17 Aug–11 Dec 2026 (Exam I 17–24 Oct, Exam II 12–19 Dec 2026); Master term 1 Sep 2026–31 Jan 2027 (lectures begin 31 Aug, end 12 Dec; Exam I 19–24 Oct, Exam II 14–19 Dec 2026).

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Summer semester 2027: Mandatory orientation 21–22 Jan 2027; Bachelor lectures 25 Jan–21 May 2027 (Exam I 13–20 Mar, Exam II 22–29 May 2027); Master term 1 Feb–31 Aug 2027 (lectures begin 11 Jan, end 22 May; Exam I 15–20 Mar, Exam II 24–29 May 2027).

final_semester_allowed.notes: AY 2026-27 Fact Sheet #page=2 does not forbid final-semester students, but strongly advises against relying on specific FS courses to meet graduation requirements because course enrollment is not guaranteed.

tuition_model.notes: Standard FS tuition fees are waived for incoming exchange students nominated under partner exchange agreements; mandatory Deutschlandticket and Student Council fees still apply.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Official FS International Student Guide ('Before you Apply') cites DAAD guidance of EUR 900–1,200/month covering accommodation, groceries, health insurance, transport, communication, study materials, and personal expenses (note AY 2026-27 Fact Sheet #page=2 also lists optional i-Live dorm rent at EUR 770/month).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month USD midpoint estimate derived from EUR 900–1,200/month range (midpoint EUR 1,050/mo x 5 = EUR 5,250) converted at ECB 2026-11-13 reference rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD (collected 2026-11-15 via https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html): 5,250 x 1.1052 = 5,802.30 USD.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory reduced Deutschlandticket (~EUR 189/semester) and Student Council fee (EUR 15/semester) apply to all enrolled students regardless of length of stay. Compulsory German-equivalent unlimited health insurance covering the full semester (travel insurance rejected; checked at mandatory orientation, or students must enroll in German insurance at ~EUR 105/month).

housing_notes.value: Limited furnished on-campus apartments (private bath and kitchenette) reserved with dorm partner i-Live on a first-come, first-served basis (not guaranteed; apply within online exchange application). Fixed 6-month solidarity contracts (15 Jan–14 Jul or 15 Jul–14 Jan) at EUR 770/month (14-day withdrawal period, after which full 6-month rent applies; contracted directly with i-Live). Other Frankfurt options: http://www.frankfurt-school.de/en/home/about/campus/dorms

citizenship_restrictions.notes: No citizenship restrictions stated; non-EU nationals require a pre-arrival German student visa.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Compulsory pre-arrival German student visa for non-EU students (arranged individually via local German embassy; must be valid for mandatory pre-semester orientation days per AY 2026-27 Fact Sheet #page=2). German Federal Foreign Office blocked-account financial standard is EUR 992/month (EUR 11,904/year) per https://www.auswaertiges-amt.de/en/sperrkonto/388600.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credits (each FS module = 6 ECTS). Exchange workload: minimum 1 module (6 ECTS), maximum 5 modules (30 ECTS) per semester including optional 6-ECTS German course.

course_restrictions_note.value: Bachelor exchange limited to 6th and 7th semester BA modules; most Master modules open subject to availability. Add/drop available before semester start; enrollment in specific courses not guaranteed. Lectures and exams run Monday–Saturday (#page=1); exam dates released ~1–2 weeks before exam week.

international_support_services.value: Mandatory International Student Orientation (campus tour, FS Online Campus onboarding, compulsory health insurance check), optional semester German course (6 ECTS) and August intensive German course, dedicated Incoming Student Mobility Manager (Patricia Escalera, p.escalera@fs.de; #page=2), International Office walk-in hours Mon–Fri 9:00–16:00 and 24/7 campus reception (#page=3).

value: Proof of English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS or home university supporting letter)

fact_sheet_status.notes: Excel Col H blank, but matching public folder found in Drive master folder

min_standing_note.notes: No specific semester-count prerequisite listed in WSU 2026-27 or 2025-26 Fact Sheets (exchange open to UG/GR per Excel, though 500+ grad courses closed per Fact Sheet p.2).

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Exact University-wide agreement scope.

eligible_majors.notes: Exact University-wide agreement scope.

excluded_majors.notes: Courses outside the Pullman campus and 500+ graduate-level courses are not open to exchange students (further restrictions under Academics tab in myStudyAbroad).

min_gpa_host.notes: Good academic standing via home university/WSU 4.0 grading system noted on 2025-26 p.1; no fixed numeric incoming-exchange GPA threshold stated in Fact Sheets.

instruction_languages.notes: All courses are taught in English.

english_course_availability.notes: US land-grant research university teaching all courses in English.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: English test within past 2 years: Duolingo 105, IELTS 6.5, or TOEFL iBT 4 (2026 ETS 1-6 scale; 2025-26 sheet listed TOEFL iBT 79). Or qualify for Waiver Option E or F at https://ip.wsu.edu/future-students/requirements/.

host_language_requirement.value: English only.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall Term (incl. exams): Mon Aug 24 - Fri Dec 18, 2026 (Mandatory Orientation Friday before first day of classes).

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Spring Term (incl. exams): Mon Jan 11 - Fri May 7, 2027 (Mandatory Orientation Friday prior).

tuition_model.notes: Bilateral exchange covers standard 12-18 credit load (base tuition omitted from COA table p.3); >18 credit overload incurs per-credit tuition (~$577.75/cr as of 2023 per 2025-26 p.1).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived monthly cost from WSU 2024-25 Cost of Attendance (latest published itemized sheet in Drive) divided by 5 months: Room & Board $8,887 + Books & Supplies $381 + Transportation/Misc $1,821 = $11,089/semester -> $2,217.80/mo (~$2,218/mo). Total COA incl. Mandatory Fees ($794) + Health Insurance ($1,100 Fall / $1,532 Spring) = $12,933/sem ($25,866/AY).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate derived from monthly USD range 2,218/month. No FX conversion (1 USD = 1.0 USD; 5-month equivalent = 5 * 2,218.0 USD = 11,090.00 USD), calculated 2026-11-15.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: 2024-25 Fact Sheet baseline per semester: Mandatory Fees $794/sem + mandatory WSU International Student Health Insurance $1,100 (Fall) / $1,532 (Spring/Summer) / $2,632 (AY) — strict US-comparable waiver rules (most students double-covered).

housing_availability.notes: 2026-27 Fact Sheet p.2 states 'On-campus housing is guaranteed'; 2025-26 p.3 notes all exchange students are required to live in University housing (residence halls or University apartments) during vacation periods as well.

housing_notes.value: Arranged via WSU Housing & Residence Life (http://housing.wsu.edu/); variable dining plans available in residence halls (~$8,887/sem combined room & board in 2024-25 COA).

host_grants_or_stipends.value: None; 2025-26 Fact Sheet p.3 explicitly states 'Exchange students are not eligible to apply for University scholarships'.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 Visa (Form DS-2019) requires proof of funding equating the billable Cost of Attendance under myStudyAbroad Costs tab (Certificate of Finances; $12,933/sem or $25,866/AY in 2024-25 baseline).

course_catalog_url.notes: Live term schedule of classes also linked on 2026-27 p.2 at https://schedules.wsu.edu/.

english_course_list_url.notes: All courses in https://schedules.wsu.edu/ and http://catalog.wsu.edu/Pullman/Courses are taught in English; no separate English-only URL.

credit_system_and_load.value: US semester credit hours (1 cr = 15 in-class hrs; most courses 3 cr). Limit: 12 credits min (immigration floor) to 18 credits max; 15 credits recommended (>18 cr billed extra per credit).

course_restrictions_note.value: Restricted to WSU Pullman campus (100-400 undergraduate levels; 500+ graduate courses and non-Pullman campuses excluded); prerequisites enforced and preferred courses cannot be guaranteed.

value: Online nomination (Signature Verification Form, signed ID/Passport copy, Official Transcripts, optional Language of Instruction letter)
Proof of English proficiency (within 2 years, or Waiver Option E/F)

academic_style.value: US public land-grant research university (~15:1 student-faculty ratio, 200+ study fields; syllabi strictly enforce assignment due dates even without in-class reminders).

city_tier.notes: pullman.wsu.edu explicitly describes WSU Pullman as 'Located in a classic college town' (2025-26 Fact Sheet p.1 gives town population ~31,000).

campus_type.notes: Pullman campus set in Palouse agricultural/wheat region (2025-26 p.1); no explicit rural vs suburban enum term used.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: Not explicitly rated in Fact Sheets or wsu.edu (US English-speaking college town).

international_support_services.value: WSU Education Abroad / Office of International Programs, mandatory Orientation, Pullman Regional Airport arrival pickup (or Spokane shuttle), Cougar Health insurance, Recreation Center, 250+ clubs.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall/AY: Nomination Apr 1, Application Apr 15. Spring/Calendar Year: Nomination Oct 1, Application Oct 15 (note: 2026-27 Fact Sheet p.1 erroneously transposed Fall/Spring headings vs 2025-26 Fact Sheet p.2 and ip.wsu.edu).

min_standing_note.value: Must be nominated by partner university (cannot transfer to Wellesley); women's college gender policy considers applicants who consistently live and identify as women (cisgender, trans, and nonbinary students who consistently live and identify as women).
min_standing_note.notes: Partner nomination requirement and non-transfer status stated on 2026-2027 Factsheet page 1 and https://www.wellesley.edu/interstudy/exchange/incoming.

eligible_auc_schools.notes: University-wide UG exchange agreement (Fall/Spring); note Wellesley women's college gender policy in citizenship_restrictions.

eligible_majors.notes: Open across 55 majors (~1,000+ courses) EXCEPT Computer Science.

excluded_majors.notes: 2026-2027 Factsheet page 3 explicitly states: 'Exchange students are NOT eligible to enroll in Computer Science courses.'

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Non-native English speakers must submit proof of English proficiency: TOEFL score of 100 or equivalent on a comparable test.

host_language_requirement.value: None (instruction is in English)

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall 2026: Arrival Aug 21, 2026; Classes Aug 31 – Dec 9, 2026; End of exam period Dec 17, 2026.

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Spring 2027: Arrival mid-January (TBA); Classes Jan 25 – May 5, 2027; End of exam period May 13, 2027.

tuition_model.notes: 2026-2027 Factsheet page 2 states: 'Tuition: Exchange students continue to pay regular tuition to their home institution.'

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Wellesley 2026-2027 SFS budget lists Academic Year Housing ($12,020) + Meals ($11,186) + Books ($800) + Personal Expenses ($1,250) = $25,256/year ($12,628/semester), prorated across a 5-month semester = $2,525.60 USD/month.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month exchange semester estimate: ($12,020 housing + $11,186 meals + $800 books + $1,250 personal) / 2 semesters = $12,628.00 USD/semester ($2,525.60 USD/month * 5 months * 1.0 = $12,628 USD, 1 USD = 1.0 USD, checked 2026-11-15).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory Student Activity Fee ($360/year per SFS), Wellesley meal plan, automatic Wellesley Student Health Insurance Plan (unless waived with US-based MA/J-1 compliant plan), and Health History & Immunization Form.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: SFS Student Activity Fee $360/year on https://www.wellesley.edu/sfs/cost; Health Form deadlines (Jul 1 Fall / Dec 1 Spring) in Wellesley College.docx.

housing_availability.notes: 2026-2027 Factsheet page 2 states: 'Exchange students are required to live in on-campus housing, typically in a double occupancy room ... randomly placed in one of our 15 residence halls' and automatically enrolled in the Wellesley meal plan.

housing_notes.value: Mandatory on-campus furnished residence hall (typically double occupancy) + automatic Wellesley meal plan (4 dining halls); room/board billed per semester ($12,020 housing + $11,186 meals/yr in 2026-2027).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 DS-2019 requires Certification of Finances showing ~$14,000 USD/semester (inclusive of activity fee, housing, meal plan, and health insurance) plus $1,250 USD for books/supplies/personal expenses.

course_catalog_url.notes: Course catalog link embedded on page 3 (also https://www.wellesley.edu/academics/catalog on page 1).

credit_system_and_load.value: Wellesley unit system: 1 Wellesley unit = 4 US credit hours = 7.5 ECTS (~12 hrs/week work); normal full load is 4 classes (~4 units); minimum 3 units required to maintain immigration status and housing.

course_restrictions_note.value: Computer Science courses are NOT open to exchange students; cross-registration limited to max 1 course/semester at MIT, Olin College of Engineering, Babson College, or Brandeis University (MIT UROP excluded; single-semester students strongly encouraged to take all courses at Wellesley).

value: Official transcripts from all previous university coursework (English translation if applicable)
Proof of English proficiency (TOEFL 100 or equivalent, non-native speakers)
required_application_docs.notes: COF on page 2; Health History & Immunization Form in Wellesley College.docx.

academic_style.value: US-style liberal arts

international_support_services.value: Mandatory Orientation & Slater International Center J-1 check-in, Class Dean academic advising, and Accessibility & Disability Resources.
international_support_services.notes: Also page 3.

nomination_deadlines.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall / Full Year: Nomination Feb 15, 2026 / Application Mar 15, 2026; Spring 2027: Nomination Sep 15, 2026 / Application Oct 1, 2026.

value: Practicums, seminars, and independent study (case-by-case only)
excluded_majors.notes: Medicine, Nursing, Law, and Dentistry require >=6 months advance application; Law requires completed Bachelor's; Graduate courses need departmental permission.

min_gpa_host.notes: Fact sheet p.2 states: 'MINIMUM GPA: 2.5/4.0. Students with a GPA of 2.0-2.49 may be considered on an individual basis. Course request list required for review.'

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Required for non-native English speakers: TOEFL iBT 79 / PBT 550, IELTS 6.5, or Duolingo English Test 105 (Fact sheet p.2; RHET 1020 / English-medium waiver not mentioned).

host_language_requirement.value: English (TOEFL iBT 79 / PBT 550, IELTS 6.5, or Duolingo 105 for non-native speakers).

fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026: Registration Aug 17; Classes begin Aug 18, 2026; Fall Break Oct 9-11; Final Exam Week Dec 7-11, 2026 (arrive ~1 week prior for mandatory New International Student Orientation; no late arrivals).
fall_term_dates.notes: Orientation arrival & no-late-arrival rule on data/raw/factsheets/West Virginia/2025-2026/WVU 202526 Fact sheet.pdf#page=1.

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2027: Registration Jan 8; Classes begin Jan 11, 2027; Final Exam Week May 3-7, 2027 (arrive ~1 week prior for mandatory New International Student Orientation; no late arrivals).
spring_term_dates.notes: Orientation arrival rule on data/raw/factsheets/West Virginia/2025-2026/WVU 202526 Fact sheet.pdf#page=1.

tuition_model.notes: WVU 2025-26 Fact Sheet notes a $150 USD admin fee and 'WVU Exchange Housing Waiver, if included in institutional agreement', without publicly printing a standard incoming tuition-waiver statement on educationabroad.wvu.edu/incoming.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived from WVU 2026-27 average on-campus Food & Housing COA ($15,028/year divided across 10 academic months / two 5-month semesters = $1,502.80/month). Excludes $150 admin fee and SHIP health insurance ($1,277 Fall / $1,980 Spring-Summer); note select agreements include WVU Exchange Housing Waiver (Stalnaker Hall).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 1 USD = 1.0 USD on 2026-11-15 (native USD); 5-month semester equivalent of WVU 2026-27 average Food & Housing COA ($15,028/yr / 2 = $7,514.00/semester), excluding $150 admin fee and health insurance.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: WVU 2026-27 Aetna Student Health Insurance Plan (SHIP) premiums: $1,277 Fall, $1,980 Spring/Summer ($3,257 annual). J-1 exchange visitors must meet 22 CFR 62.14 insurance minimums ($100k medical, $25k repatriation, $50k evacuation, <=$500 deductible). WVU also charges a $150 USD exchange administration fee.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: J-1 insurance criteria at https://isss.wvu.edu/students-services/health-insurance-in-the-u-s; $150 administration fee at data/raw/factsheets/West Virginia/2025-2026/WVU 202526 Fact sheet.pdf#page=1.

housing_availability.notes: Global Live-Learn Community at Stalnaker Hall (covered by WVU Exchange Housing Waiver if included in partner agreement); students >=24 are ineligible for residence halls (University Apartments recommended for >19). Note WVU housing/dining close during breaks (Thanksgiving/Winter/Spring) — Fact sheet p.1.

housing_notes.value: Morgantown residence hall rates per semester: Traditional towers double ~$3,682, single ~$4,628; Stalnaker/Summit double suite ~$4,038-$4,133, single ~$4,759-$4,863; Honors/Lincoln double ~$4,660-$4,729, single ~$4,863-$4,936; Seneca studios $5,718-$6,248; $225 deposit and required dining plan.
housing_notes.notes: WVU 2025-26 Fact Sheet (data/raw/factsheets/West Virginia/2025-2026/WVU 202526 Fact sheet.pdf#page=1, #page=2) also specifies Global LLC at Stalnaker Hall (housing waiver if included in agreement), >=24 residence hall age cap, and hall/dining closures during breaks.

citizenship_restrictions.notes: Age rule for housing: students 24 years old or older are not permitted in WVU residence halls (Fact sheet p.2).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 Visa requires Form DS-2019 from WVU ISSS supported by Proof of Financial Support (liquid bank statements <=6 months old or sponsor/award letters covering COA; add $9,700 per J-2 dependent) and 22 CFR 62.14 compliant health insurance.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Financial documentation rules ($9,700/dependent) at https://isss.wvu.edu/students-services/new-student-on-boarding; Fact Sheet (data/raw/factsheets/West Virginia/2025-2026/WVU 202526 Fact sheet.pdf#page=2) also lists .../students/j-1-students.

english_course_list_url.notes: All coursework on Morgantown Campus delivered in English.

credit_system_and_load.value: US semester credit-hour system: mandatory minimum 12 credit hours/semester UG (courses 100-499) and 9 credit hours/semester GR (courses 500+).

course_restrictions_note.value: Morgantown Campus courses only (WVUIT and Potomac State not open; no online courses). Forensics, Pharmacy, and MBA closed; Medicine/Nursing/Law/Dentistry require 6-month advance application (Law requires bachelor's degree); graduate courses need departmental permission; practicums/seminars/independent study generally closed.

value: Home institution nomination emailed to incomingexchange@mail.wvu.edu (name, email, field, level)
Official transcript showing >=2.5 GPA (2.0-2.49 needs course request list for individual review)
English proficiency scores (TOEFL 79 / IELTS 6.5 / DET 105 for non-native speakers)
Proof of financial support for DS-2019
required_application_docs.notes: Academic/GPA/English & DS-2019 requirements on data/raw/factsheets/West Virginia/2025-2026/WVU 202526 Fact sheet.pdf#page=2.

campus_type.notes: Morgantown Campus spans Downtown, Evansdale, and Sunnyside neighborhoods in Morgantown, WV (WVUIT and Potomac State campuses are closed to exchange students).

international_support_services.value: Education Abroad (incomingexchange@mail.wvu.edu), International Students & Scholars Services (ISSS, https://isss.wvu.edu/), mandatory New International Student Orientation, scheduled shuttle pickups from Pittsburgh International Airport, Stalnaker Hall Global LLC, and Accessibility Services.
international_support_services.notes: ISSS/Accessibility/Emergency contact on data/raw/factsheets/West Virginia/2025-2026/WVU 202526 Fact sheet.pdf#page=2.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall (Aug-Dec): Nomination Mar 15, Application Apr 1. Spring (Jan-May): Nomination Sep 1, Application Sep 15 (late apps case-by-case; Medicine/Nursing/Law/Dentistry >=6 months advance).
nomination_deadlines.notes: 6-month advance rule for health/law programs on p.2.

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Agreement scope literally says 'AENG major' (Architectural Engineering belongs to AUC's School of Sciences and Engineering, SSE).

eligible_majors.notes: Restricted to Architectural Engineering (AENG) majors per Excel agreement scope.

english_course_availability.notes: English-taught tracks and courses are offered alongside Turkish-taught programs; verify Architecture/AENG teaching languages in Bologna catalog.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: B1–B2 English level required/recommended for English-taught courses.

host_language_requirement.value: B1 Turkish required/recommended for Turkish-taught courses; B1–B2 English for English-taught courses.

fall_term_dates.value: Fall semester typically runs late September–mid-January.
fall_term_dates.notes: Verify annual dates on YTU Erasmus Academic Calendar (also https://erasmus.yildiz.edu.tr/page/Academic-Calendar/16).

spring_term_dates.value: Spring semester typically starts around February with exams extending through June.
spring_term_dates.notes: Verify annual dates on YTU Erasmus Academic Calendar (also https://erasmus.yildiz.edu.tr/page/Academic-Calendar/16).

tuition_model.notes: Incoming Erasmus and bilateral exchange students under active inter-institutional agreements do not pay tuition fees to YTU.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Valid health insurance covering the entire mobility period is required (especially for Turkish residence permit applications); students pay residence permit card fees and tax.

housing_availability.notes: YTU does not offer on-campus dormitories for incoming exchange or international students; students arrange off-campus accommodation.

housing_notes.value: No university dormitory spots for incoming exchange students; students rent shared apartments or private Istanbul dormitories (landlords typically require 1–2 months security deposit upfront), with support from ESN Yildiz and buddy program.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Foreign exchange students staying >90 days must apply online for a Turkish student residence permit via https://e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr/ regardless of nationality, holding full-period health insurance and paying card/tax fees (extensions typically applied ~60 days before expiry).

course_catalog_url.notes: Official YTU Bologna Information System listing ECTS credits and course languages.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system; standard full-time exchange load is 30 ECTS per semester.

academic_style.value: Turkish public technical university following Bologna ECTS frameworks across Istanbul campuses (Faculty of Architecture / AENG is located at historic Yıldız Campus in Beşiktaş; other faculties at Davutpaşa Campus).

campus_type.notes: Distinct Istanbul campuses: Yıldız Campus (Beşiktaş, Faculty of Architecture/AENG) and Davutpaşa Campus.

international_support_services.value: ESN Yildiz and buddy program support for incoming exchange students (housing assistance, residence permit guidance, welcome activities).

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall/AY: nom Apr 30 / app Jun 1–30; Spring: nom Sep 30 / app Dec 1–31 (Nov 1–30 also noted on prior cycle info; online portal www.ytuerasmus.yildiz.edu.tr).
